source_policydoc: Directive 2010/75/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council
justification: The implementation of the Directive 2010/75/EU can aid the achievement of the Energy from Renewable Sources target by promoting the use of renewable energy sources, thus reinforcing the transition to a low-carbon economy.

source_policydoc: On the quality of water intended for human consumption
impact_policydoc: On energy efficiency and amending Regulation (EU) 2023/955 (recast)
justification: The quality of water intended for human consumption can enable education and awareness about the importance of energy efficiency, thus creating conditions that further the energy efficiency target.

source_policydoc: Pathway to a Healthy Planet for All EU Action Plan
justification: The Pathway to a Healthy Planet for All EU Action Plan can indivisibly support the achievement of the A Renovation Wave for Europe target by promoting sustainable practices and reducing pollution, thus creating a healthy environment that reinforces the renovation wave initiative.

source_policydoc: European assessment framework for ‘safe and sustainable by design’ chemicals and materials
justification: The European assessment framework can reinforce the packaging and packaging waste target by promoting sustainable practices and reducing waste, thus creating conditions that further the reduction of packaging waste.

source_policydoc: On reporting of environmental data from industrial installations and establishing an Industrial Emissions Portal
impact_policydoc: On the Energy Performance of Buildings (recast)
justification: The reporting of environmental data can enable the energy performance of buildings target by providing data and insights that inform building renovation and energy efficiency measures, thus creating conditions that further the energy performance target.

source_policydoc: On ambient air quality and cleaner air for Europe
justification: The ambient air quality target can reinforce the REPowerEU Plan by promoting cleaner air and reducing pollution, thus creating conditions that further the transition to renewable energy sources.

The REPowerEU Plan can indivisibly support the achievement of the Energy from Renewable Sources target by promoting the use of renewable energy sources and reducing dependence on fossil fuels, thus creating a low-carbon economy that reinforces the energy from renewable sources target.

impact_policydoc: Delivering on the EU offshore renewable energy ambitions
justification: The EU Solar Energy Strategy can reinforce the Delivering on the EU offshore renewable energy ambitions target by promoting the use of solar energy and reducing pollution, thus creating conditions that further the offshore renewable energy ambitions.

source_policydoc: Delivering on the EU offshore renewable energy ambitions
justification: The Delivering on the EU offshore renewable energy ambitions target can enable the Powering a Climate neutrality economy target by promoting offshore renewable energy and reducing greenhouse gas emissions, thus creating conditions that further the climate neutrality target.
